book.name: 1 Bhakolinso
book.title: Baluwa ja kutumbula jaka Paulo kwa Bhakolinso

content: Ubholu kubhokana na kuwambakika kwaka Kristo punsalaba
Bhalongu bhangu, nepani panahikiki kwinu hoku, ngachenahikiki kuntangazila sili jaka Chapanga kwa kunyamba kwa malobhi, wala kwa mbulau ja bhandu.
Panabhi kwinu nakapaliki nganimanya lilobhi lokapi kwinu, nambu pe kummanya Yesu Kristo, na kupotela kwaki punsalaba.
Panabhi kwinu nakabhi zaifu, na kubhaghaja kwa lujoghopu lukolongwa.
Malobhi ghangu na kutangaza kwangu ngachekwabhi kwa malobhi gha mbulau ja kughahuta malangu gha bhandu, nambu kwa nginyulila ja makili ghaka Roho Mhuhu.
Nakatendiki bhenibhela nahuli uhobhalelu winu ngawikubha mu mbulau ja bhandu, nambu mu makili ghaka Chapanga.
Hata bhela, tepani tutumi lugha ja mbulau kwa bhala bhabhakolike kiroho, nambu mbulau heji nga ja pani pundema, wala nga ja bhajemalela bha ndema ghoni bhabhabhili munkumbu wa kuhobha.
Nambu tepani tuntangazila mbulau jaka Chapanga jejihiyakike, ambaju Chapanga akabhi ajomwili kujihaghula kwa ndandi ja ulumbalilu witu, hata mangani ja kubhombakeka kwa ndema ghoni.
Nde mbulau ambaju bhajemalela bha ndema ghoni ngachebhakajieliwe, maghambu ngati bhakabhi bhatehi kujielewa, ngachebhakamuwambiki punsalaba Bambo wa ulumbalilu.
Nambu, nde ngati moghapwaghi Malembu Mahuhu,

content.text: “Mambu ambaghu lihu ngachelighaweni wala likutu kughajowana,
mambu ambaghu mundu ngachealabhali kughaholalela muntima waki,
ghanihagha nde Chapanga ghaabhekile bhandu bhala bhabhumpala.”

content: Nambu Chapanga atuyekulili tepani mambu ghanihagha kwa Roho waki. Ndandi Roho Mhuhu alingalila kila chindu, hata mambu gha mkati nakanopi jaka Chapanga.
Bho, nde nane pachilanda ja bhandu joaweza kughamanya mambu ghaka mundu jongi nambu pe roho jejibhi mkati jaka mundu hoju? Bhelabhela na mambu ghaka Chapanga ngajoaghamanya, nambu Roho waka Chapanga.
Nambu tepani ngachetwajopalili roho ja ndema ghoni, nambu Roho joahuma kwaka Chapanga, nahuli tuwezaje kughamanya ghokapi ghatupekiwi waka na Chapanga.
Naghombi tughalongela, nga kwa malobhi ghaghabholakeka kwa mbulau ja bhandu, nambu kwa malobhi ghaghabholakeka na Roho Mhuhu, koni tukaghayekulaje mambu gha kiroho kwa bhandu bha kiroho.

Bhela mundu jwangakubha na Roho waka Chapanga ngacheaweza kughajopalela mambu ghaka Roho waka Chapanga. Maghambu mambu ghanihagha kwaka mundu jonihoju nde ung'ang'a, wala ngacheaweza kughamanya, kwa ndandi ghamanyikana kwa kujangatiwa na Roho waka Chapanga.
Kwa ndandi mundu joabhi na Roho waka Chapanga aweza kughapema mambu ghokapi, nambu njeta mundu joaweza kuntemula.

content.text: “Bho, nde nane joaweza kughamanya malangu ghaka Bambo?”

content: Nambu tepani tubhi na malangu ghaka Kristo.
